people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.
translations.bsb: After the voice had spoken, only Jesus was present with them. The disciples kept this to themselves, and in those days they did not tell anyone what they had seen.
translations.kjv: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.
translations.asv: And when the voice came, Jesus was found alone. And they held their peace, and told no man in those days any of the things which they had seen.
